raw_translation: Kyakkyawan wasa na arcade da sakamako na mafarki kawai. Ba ta da ƙungiyoyi na gaskiya, bayanan 'yan wasa, sakamakon gasar ko kuma saka hannun jari.
source: Original arcade game with fictional outcomes only. It has no real teams, player data, match results or betting.
translation: Kyakkyawan wasa na arcade da sakamako na mafarki kawai. Ba ta da ƙungiyoyi na gaskiya, bayanan 'yan wasa, sakamakon gasar ko kuma saka hannun jari.
